conditions.timing: Render-loop wall time including GPU completion and image readback; excludes loading, initialization, warmup, and image saving.

current_configuration.triangle_intersection: Double-precision ray-aligned edge functions; consistent barycentric UV/normal interpolation.
current_configuration.traversal: Cached reciprocals, validated fast traversal, active near child/deferred far siblings, cross-mesh closest-distance pruning.
current_configuration.release_scheduling: No forced per-stage synchronization; headless rendering defers readback until capture and skips preview conversion.
current_configuration.object_acceleration: World-space object AABB and TLAS candidates rejected and rolled back; current source retains mesh BVHs.

interpretation.headline: About 3.03x the original speed, or about 67% less render-loop time for this showcase.
interpretation.comparison_scope: Matched scene/resolution/sample count/depth and display/camera settings, recorded in separate development stages. This is an approximate historical comparison, not a new simultaneous old/current A/B benchmark; GPU clocks were not locked.
interpretation.do_not_multiply: Per-stage speedup factors use different baselines and must not be multiplied to obtain the overall result.
interpretation.latest_record_selector: The current 64-spp row uses the previous entry in the object-acceleration experiment: that entry is the frozen, preserved production renderer. Neither experimental AABB nor TLAS is included.
interpretation.numerical_scope: The current renderer includes thin-triangle precision corrections. Some pixels intentionally differ from the original float renderer; see robust_traversal_verification.json. Geometry and camera settings are unchanged.
interpretation.full_capture_scope: The 3072-spp values are one measured full capture each, not extrapolations from the 64-spp benchmark.
